Lowpoly Scanner

Walk a full circle around your dog at a steady distance, taking evenly spaced photos (or one slow video). 24–40 views works well.

1 · Photos or video

No photos yet

2 · Find the dog in each photo

Click a thumbnail to exclude a bad view. Green outline = dog mask.

3 · Match the walk-around

Tweak until the mesh looks right. Show cameras to see where the app thinks each photo was taken.

4 · Export

GLB opens directly in Unity (via glTFast), Unreal, Godot, Blender and Three.js. Origin is at the feet, Y up, metres.
